notes: POPETS-X08_minimal_privacy (Phase P04, RQ3): implemented minimal outbound disclosure control in evaluation/venue2027/popets/minimal_disclosure.py adhering to task dependency + active purpose rather than original full EHR summary. Restricts disclosed context to the minimal field set demanded by the task and authorized by purpose; reports withheld fields and payload. Fails closed on any unresolved or unknown graph edge (missing ancestor, unlinked derivation, cross-purpose edge) by falling back to RECOMPUTATION (recomputation_required=True, reason_code=REASON_RECOMPUTATION_REQUIRED). Actively refuses full EHR summary disclosure when a strictly minimal context set exists (reason_code=REASON_FULL_SUMMARY_DISCLOSURE_REFUSED). Implements exact target contract select_fields(context, task) -> FieldSet and minimal_disclosure(task_dependency, current_purpose, graph) -> Disclosure. 9 unit tests in evaluation/venue2027/popets/test_minimal_privacy.py pass cleanly (positive controls for narrow task disclosure reduction, purpose change narrowing, lineage-backed resolution, select_fields contract; adversarial controls for unknown graph edge recomputation fallback, cross-purpose edge fallback, full summary refusal, malformed inputs).
